notes: 9-case standalone unit test suite run against extracted function definitions (bypassing the env-var-gated MAIN block) confirmed: Acrobat Capture + OCRmyPDF/Tesseract detection, non-OCR non-detection, structural-only heading acceptance, mid-sentence bold/large rejection with NO producer metadata (proves cue path not producer-gated -- explicit Phase 7 verification criterion), font-only rejection under ocr_hint=True without numbering, structural acceptance under ocr_hint=True, font-only acceptance preserved for non-OCR docs, and empty-line rejection. bash -n and py_compile both pass. derive_toc_markdown and run_quality_gate/column_interleaving_flagged/sentence_boundary_glue_count re-read byte-identical to pre-edit content (line numbers unchanged, only shifted down by the insertion).
